column1: The statement is balanced—acknowledging further progress toward 2% inflation and risks moving into better balance—while clearly maintaining a high-for-long stance (5.25–5.50% target range, continued QT, and a confidence threshold before cuts). Incorporating the Financial Stability Report tilts the tone slightly more cautious than a simple read: it highlights vulnerabilities from persistent inflation pressures, higher long-term rates, commercial real estate stress, leverage in nonbanks, periodic Treasury market liquidity strains, and fiscal debt sustainability concerns, alongside resilience signals such as stabilized bank deposits, the wind-down of emergency facilities, and some recovery in securitization markets. On net, this supports cautious optimism but closer to neutral than the headline suggests, given macro-financial risks that could constrain easing. sentiment score = 0.15
